title: Claude Code 2.1.251 — Watch subagents work live #Shorts
description:
Foreground subagents now stream their tool calls and results live to Remote Control clients, so you can watch exactly what they're doing in real time.

Full release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.251

📋 Full changelog: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
